searchText: I'm trying to create verkle tree for the block 0 of devnet6, using [genesis](https://github.com/ethpandaops/verkle-devnets/blob/master/network-configs/gen-devnet-6/genesis.json). I'm trying to figure out what I'm not doing correctly, and it's a bit hard because all I know is that my root doesn't match. Can somebody answer following questions: - Which of the `VERSION`, `BALANCE`, `NONCE`, `CODE_KECCAK` and `CODE_SIZE` are always set for EOA and which one for Smart Contracts (assuming they are default values)? - Is there a way to export all key/value pairs that are set during genesis creation from geth or some other implementation? <@261161007982968833> , i did a `geth init genesis.json` with some extra "tree dump" code to get all leaves Oh, that's perfect. Thanks! Thanks to <@774033563732541451>'s tree dump, I was able to figure out the difference and it works now. I was reading the contract storage key/value as U256 big endian, but it seems that key is big endian while value is small endian. There is still one thing that I'm confused about. Wasn't there a recent change to use *commitment_hash* (scalar value) for trie root (same as other inner nodes) instead of *commitment* (elliptic curve point)? Or is that a plan for the next testnet? Because it seems that trie root is still EC point. There was some discussion around that some time ago, but that kind of change wouldn't work since to verify the verkle proof the block header state root is your source of truth, and you need the point (not a hash). you could put the hash in the block root, but then you'd need to also provide the compressed point in the witness adding some extra bytes (and do the verification) that i'm nto sure we gain much from that Ok, makes sense. Just wanted to be sure what is the status about that.

I'm trying to create verkle tree for the block 0 of devnet6, using [genesis](https://github.com/ethpandaops/verkle-devnets/blob/master/network-configs/gen-devnet-6/genesis.json).
I'm trying to figure out what I'm not doing correctly, and it's a bit hard because all I know is that my root doesn't match. Can somebody answer following questions:

- Which of the `VERSION`, `BALANCE`, `NONCE`, `CODE_KECCAK` and `CODE_SIZE` are always set for EOA and which one for Smart Contracts (assuming they are default values)?
- Is there a way to export all key/value pairs that are set during genesis creation from geth or some other implementation?

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: <@261161007982968833>  , i did a `geth init genesis.json` with some extra "tree dump" code to get all leaves

excerpts.author: milos88
excerpts.content:
Thanks to <@774033563732541451>'s tree dump, I was able to figure out the difference and it works now.

I was reading the contract storage key/value as U256 big endian, but it seems that key is big endian while value is small endian.

excerpts.author: milos88
excerpts.content:
There is still one thing that I'm confused about.
Wasn't there a recent change to use *commitment_hash* (scalar value) for trie root (same as other inner nodes) instead of *commitment* (elliptic curve point)? Or is that a plan for the next testnet? Because it seems that trie root is still EC point.

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: There was some discussion around that some time ago, but that kind of change wouldn't work since to verify the verkle proof the block header state root is your source of truth, and you need the point (not a hash).

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: you could put the hash in the block root, but then you'd need to also provide the compressed point in the witness adding some extra bytes (and do the verification) that i'm nto sure we gain much from that

excerpts.author: milos88
excerpts.content: Ok, makes sense. Just wanted to be sure what is the status about that.
